args.knowledge_name: Correlation Between Resource Adequacy and Adherence (CRAA)

args.sql:
WITH parsed_facilities AS (
    SELECT 
        fackey, 
        (
            support_and_resources->>'resource_adequacy_score'
        )::NUMERIC AS resource_adequacy_score
    FROM facilities
),
treatment_adherence AS (
    SELECT 
        facid, 
        AVG(
            CASE 
                WHEN txadh = 'High' THEN 3
                WHEN txadh = 'Medium' THEN 2
                WHEN txadh = 'Low' THEN 1
                WHEN txadh = 'Non-compliant' THEN 0
            END
        ) AS treatment_adherence_rate
    FROM treatmentoutcomes
    JOIN encounters ON txref = txkey
    GROUP BY facid
)

SELECT 
    pf.fackey, 
    pf.resource_adequacy_score, 
    ta.treatment_adherence_rate, 
    CORR(pf.resource_adequacy_score, ta.treatment_adherence_rate) OVER () AS correlation_coefficient
FROM parsed_facilities pf
JOIN treatment_adherence ta ON pf.fackey = ta.facid;
